name: Subscription Paid Reactivation
author: Utsav tilava

sections.description:
Allow customers to reactivate cancelled subscriptions by paying a reactivation fee. Seamlessly charge and automatically restore subscriptions.

Overview

Subscription Paid Reactivation extends WooCommerce Subscriptions functionality by enabling customers to reactivate their cancelled or pending-cancel subscriptions through a one-time reactivation fee payment.

  • Customizable Reactivation Fee – Set any WooCommerce product as a reactivation fee
  • Automatic Subscription Activation – Subscriptions automatically reactivate after successful payment
  • Flexible Status Control – Choose which subscription statuses show the reactivation option
  • Custom Button Text – Personalize the reactivation button text
  • Seamless Integration – Works directly within My Account subscription pages
  • Debug Logging – Optional logging for troubleshooting
  • Secure Processing – Nonce verification and security checks throughout
  • User-Friendly – Simple one-click reactivation process for customers

How It Works

  1. Customer cancels their subscription
  2. “Reactivate” button appears on cancelled subscription page
  3. Customer clicks reactivate and is redirected to checkout
  4. Customer pays the reactivation fee
  5. Subscription automatically reactivates to active status
  6. Customer continues with their subscription
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/subscription-paid-reactivation
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Subscription Reactivation to configure settings
sections.faq:
How do I report a bug?

Please let me know what\’s going on, with as much detail as you have.
